name: haikei
description: Build and operate AI assistants with the Kei platform: ABAC API org management, kei CLI platform administration, kei-proxy runtime for agent tool calls, runtime setup, credential rotation, harness setup for Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/Pi/Cursor, agentware SDK policy/audit middleware, Kei runtime setup diagnosis, operating Kei's own platform services (deploy, rollback, migrations, signing keys, KeiIdentity* alerts), opt-in customer-held encryption of audit tool-call arguments (kei audit, age), and DVL Assistant development (ingress security, Teams integration, tool adapters, headless evals, OpenAI backends), and resource-oriented API endpoint conventions (AIP-style routes, custom methods, migrations). Includes governed connector skills (discoverable at runtime) and forkable connector skill templates. Includes step-by-step guides to build, test (deterministic table-test evals and the CI regression gate), and deploy governed agents with the agentware SDK and kei-agents.
